items.question: Trong câu "Dynamic programming (DP) is a method for solving a complex problem by breaking it down into a collection of simpler subproblems, solving each of those subproblems just once, and storing their solutions.", từ "complex" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dynamic programming (DP) is a method for solving a complex problem by breaking it down into a collection of simpler subproblems, solving each of those subproblems just once, and storing their solutions.", what does "complex" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: complex /ˈkɒmpleks/ (tính từ): phức tạp. "A complex problem" = một bài toán phức tạp; DP chia nó thành các bài toán con đơn giản hơn.
items.explanationEn: complex /ˈkɒmpleks/ (adjective): complicated. "A complex problem" has many interacting parts; DP splits it into simpler subproblems.

items.question: Trong câu "Dynamic programming (DP) is a method for solving a complex problem by breaking it down into a collection of simpler subproblems, solving each of those subproblems just once, and storing their solutions.", từ "break down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dynamic programming (DP) is a method for solving a complex problem by breaking it down into a collection of simpler subproblems, solving each of those subproblems just once, and storing their solutions.", what does "break down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (cụm từ): chia nhỏ ra. "Break something down into parts" = chia cái gì thành các phần; nghĩa khác: "the car broke down" = xe bị hỏng.
items.explanationEn: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (phrase): to split into parts. "Break something down into parts" means splitting it; another sense is "the car broke down" (stopped working).

items.question: Trong câu "Dynamic programming (DP) is a method for solving a complex problem by breaking it down into a collection of simpler subproblems, solving each of those subproblems just once, and storing their solutions.", từ "store" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dynamic programming (DP) is a method for solving a complex problem by breaking it down into a collection of simpler subproblems, solving each of those subproblems just once, and storing their solutions.", what does "store" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: store /stɔːr/ (động từ): lưu trữ. "Store the solutions" = lưu lại lời giải để dùng lại; danh từ "store" còn có nghĩa là cửa hàng.
items.explanationEn: store /stɔːr/ (verb): to keep for later. "Store the solutions" means keeping them for reuse; as a noun, "store" also means a shop.

items.question: Trong câu "The next time the same subproblem shows up, you look the answer up instead of recomputing it.", từ "look up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The next time the same subproblem shows up, you look the answer up instead of recomputing it.", what does "look up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: look up /lʊk ʌp/ (cụm từ): tra cứu. "Look the answer up" = tra lại đáp án đã lưu; tân ngữ có thể đứng giữa: look it up.
items.explanationEn: look up /lʊk ʌp/ (phrase): to search for information. "Look the answer up" means finding a stored answer; the object can sit in the middle: look it up.

items.question: Trong câu "The next time the same subproblem shows up, you look the answer up instead of recomputing it.", từ "show up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The next time the same subproblem shows up, you look the answer up instead of recomputing it.", what does "show up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: show up /ʃəʊ ʌp/ (cụm từ): xuất hiện. "The same subproblem shows up" = cùng một bài toán con lại xuất hiện; cụm này hay gặp trong văn phong thân mật.
items.explanationEn: show up /ʃəʊ ʌp/ (phrase): to appear. "The same subproblem shows up" means it appears again; the phrase is common in informal technical writing.

items.question: Trong câu "The name comes from Richard Bellman in the 1950s, when "programming" meant planning with tables; it has nothing to do with writing dynamic code.", từ "have nothing to do with" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The name comes from Richard Bellman in the 1950s, when "programming" meant planning with tables; it has nothing to do with writing dynamic code.", what does "have nothing to do with" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to have no work to do
items.explanation: have nothing to do with /hæv ˈnʌθɪŋ tə duː wɪð/ (cụm từ): không liên quan đến. "It has nothing to do with dynamic code" = cái tên không hề liên quan đến code động.
items.explanationEn: have nothing to do with /hæv ˈnʌθɪŋ tə duː wɪð/ (phrase): to be unrelated to. "It has nothing to do with dynamic code" means the name is not connected to dynamic code at all.

items.question: Trong câu "Every DP solution starts life as a recursive definition.", từ "recursive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every DP solution starts life as a recursive definition.", what does "recursive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: recursive /rɪˈkɜːsɪv/ (tính từ): đệ quy. "A recursive definition" = định nghĩa đệ quy, tự gọi lại chính nó với đầu vào nhỏ hơn.
items.explanationEn: recursive /rɪˈkɜːsɪv/ (adjective): defined in terms of itself. "A recursive definition" refers back to itself with a smaller input.

items.question: Trong câu "DP only works on problems that have both of these properties:", từ "property" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DP only works on problems that have both of these properties:", what does "property" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: property /ˈprɒpəti/ (danh từ): tính chất, đặc tính. "Have both properties" = có cả hai tính chất; nghĩa khác: property = tài sản, bất động sản.
items.explanationEn: property /ˈprɒpəti/ (noun): a characteristic. "Have both properties" means having both characteristics; another sense of property is land or buildings you own.

items.question: Trong câu "A problem has overlapping subproblems if it can be broken down into subproblems that are reused several times.", từ "reuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A problem has overlapping subproblems if it can be broken down into subproblems that are reused several times.", what does "reuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (động từ): dùng lại. "Be reused several times" = được dùng lại nhiều lần; đây chính là dấu hiệu của bài toán con chồng lấp.
items.explanationEn: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (verb): to use again. "Be reused several times" means used again and again; that is the mark of overlapping subproblems.

items.question: Trong câu "The Fibonacci sequence is the classic example: every number after the first two is the sum of the two preceding ones (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, …).", từ "preceding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Fibonacci sequence is the classic example: every number after the first two is the sum of the two preceding ones (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, …).", what does "preceding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: preceding /prɪˈsiːdɪŋ/ (tính từ): liền trước. "The two preceding ones" = hai số đứng liền trước; trái nghĩa: following (theo sau).
items.explanationEn: preceding /prɪˈsiːdɪŋ/ (adjective): coming right before. "The two preceding ones" are the two numbers just before; the opposite is "following".

items.question: Trong câu "The Fibonacci sequence is the classic example: every number after the first two is the sum of the two preceding ones (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, …).", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Fibonacci sequence is the classic example: every number after the first two is the sum of the two preceding ones (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, …).", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (danh từ): dãy (số). "The Fibonacci sequence" = dãy Fibonacci; "in sequence" = theo thứ tự lần lượt.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (noun): an ordered list. "The Fibonacci sequence" is an ordered list of numbers; "in sequence" means one after another.

items.question: Trong câu "Caching its results would only waste memory.", từ "waste" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Caching its results would only waste memory.", what does "waste" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: waste /weɪst/ (động từ): lãng phí. "Waste memory/time" = lãng phí bộ nhớ/thời gian; danh từ: "a waste of memory".
items.explanationEn: waste /weɪst/ (verb): to use up for nothing. "Waste memory/time" means using it for no benefit; noun form: "a waste of memory".

items.question: Trong câu "A problem has optimal substructure if an optimal solution can be constructed from optimal solutions of its subproblems.", từ "optimal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A problem has optimal substructure if an optimal solution can be constructed from optimal solutions of its subproblems.", what does "optimal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: optimal /ˈɒptɪməl/ (tính từ): tối ưu. "An optimal solution" = lời giải tối ưu; đừng nhầm với "optional" (tùy chọn).
items.explanationEn: optimal /ˈɒptɪməl/ (adjective): best possible. "An optimal solution" is the best possible one; do not confuse it with "optional".

items.question: Trong câu "A problem has optimal substructure if an optimal solution can be constructed from optimal solutions of its subproblems.", từ "construct" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A problem has optimal substructure if an optimal solution can be constructed from optimal solutions of its subproblems.", what does "construct" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: construct /kənˈstrʌkt/ (động từ): xây dựng, tạo nên. "Be constructed from" = được tạo nên từ; lời giải lớn được ghép từ lời giải của các bài toán con.
items.explanationEn: construct /kənˈstrʌkt/ (verb): to build. "Be constructed from" means built out of; the big solution is built from subproblem solutions.

items.question: Trong câu "If the shortest route from A to D is A -> B -> C -> D, then A -> B -> C must be the shortest route from A to C — otherwise you could swap in a shorter one and improve A to D.", từ "otherwise" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the shortest route from A to D is A -> B -> C -> D, then A -> B -> C must be the shortest route from A to C — otherwise you could swap in a shorter one and improve A to D.", what does "otherwise" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: otherwise /ˈʌðəwaɪz/ (trạng từ): nếu không thì. "Otherwise" nối hệ quả khi điều kiện trước không đúng: nếu không phải đường ngắn nhất thì ta đã thay được.
items.explanationEn: otherwise /ˈʌðəwaɪz/ (adverb): if not, or else. "Otherwise" introduces what happens if the previous statement were false.

items.question: Trong câu "If the shortest route from A to D is A -> B -> C -> D, then A -> B -> C must be the shortest route from A to C — otherwise you could swap in a shorter one and improve A to D.", từ "swap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the shortest route from A to D is A -> B -> C -> D, then A -> B -> C must be the shortest route from A to C — otherwise you could swap in a shorter one and improve A to D.", what does "swap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: swap /swɒp/ (động từ): đổi, thay thế. "Swap in a shorter one" = thay vào một đoạn ngắn hơn; "swap two elements" = hoán đổi hai phần tử.
items.explanationEn: swap /swɒp/ (verb): to exchange. "Swap in a shorter one" means replacing with a shorter piece; "swap two elements" means exchanging them.

items.question: Trong câu "The best answers of the pieces do not combine into the best answer of the whole, so DP cannot be used directly.", từ "combine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best answers of the pieces do not combine into the best answer of the whole, so DP cannot be used directly.", what does "combine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: combine /kəmˈbaɪn/ (động từ): kết hợp. "Combine into" = kết hợp thành; ở đây các đáp án tốt nhất của từng phần không ghép thành đáp án tốt nhất.
items.explanationEn: combine /kəmˈbaɪn/ (verb): to join together. "Combine into" means joining to form something; here the best pieces do not form the best whole.

items.question: Trong câu "Glue them together: A -> B -> C -> B -> D — B repeats, so it is not even a valid simple path.", từ "valid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Glue them together: A -> B -> C -> B -> D — B repeats, so it is not even a valid simple path.", what does "valid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valid /ˈvælɪd/ (tính từ): hợp lệ. "A valid path/input" = đường đi/đầu vào hợp lệ; trái nghĩa: invalid.
items.explanationEn: valid /ˈvælɪd/ (adjective): allowed by the rules. "A valid path/input" is one that satisfies the rules; the opposite is "invalid".

items.question: Trong câu "The recurrence translates directly into code:", từ "recurrence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The recurrence translates directly into code:", what does "recurrence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: recurrence /rɪˈkʌrəns/ (danh từ): hệ thức truy hồi. "Recurrence (relation)" = hệ thức truy hồi, ví dụ fib(n) = fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2).
items.explanationEn: recurrence /rɪˈkʌrəns/ (noun): a formula from earlier terms. "Recurrence (relation)" defines a term from earlier terms, e.g. fib(n) = fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2).

items.question: Trong câu "The recurrence translates directly into code:", từ "translate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The recurrence translates directly into code:", what does "translate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: translate /trænsˈleɪt/ (động từ): chuyển thành. "Translate into code" = chuyển (công thức) thành code; nghĩa gốc là dịch ngôn ngữ.
items.explanationEn: translate /trænsˈleɪt/ (verb): to turn into another form. "Translate into code" means turning a formula into code; the basic sense is changing language.

items.question: Trong câu "It is correct but disastrously slow.", từ "disastrously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is correct but disastrously slow.", what does "disastrously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: disastrously /dɪˈzɑːstrəsli/ (trạng từ): cực kỳ tệ. "Disastrously slow" = chậm một cách thảm hại; từ gốc: disaster (thảm họa).
items.explanationEn: disastrously /dɪˈzɑːstrəsli/ (adverb): terribly. "Disastrously slow" means catastrophically slow; the root word is "disaster".

items.question: Trong câu "Each call spawns two more, so the call tree roughly doubles at every level, and it is about n levels deep.", từ "spawn" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each call spawns two more, so the call tree roughly doubles at every level, and it is about n levels deep.", what does "spawn" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spawn /spɔːn/ (động từ): sinh ra, tạo ra. "Spawn a process/call" = sinh ra tiến trình/lời gọi mới; nghĩa gốc là cá đẻ trứng.
items.explanationEn: spawn /spɔːn/ (verb): to create, to produce. "Spawn a process/call" means creating a new one; the original sense is fish laying eggs.

items.question: Trong câu "Each call spawns two more, so the call tree roughly doubles at every level, and it is about n levels deep.", từ "roughly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each call spawns two more, so the call tree roughly doubles at every level, and it is about n levels deep.", what does "roughly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: roughly /ˈrʌfli/ (trạng từ): xấp xỉ. "Roughly doubles" = tăng khoảng gấp đôi; nghĩa khác: "treat roughly" = đối xử thô bạo.
items.explanationEn: roughly /ˈrʌfli/ (adverb): approximately. "Roughly doubles" means approximately doubles; another sense is "treat someone roughly" (violently).

items.question: Trong câu "The usual upper bound quoted is O(2ⁿ) time.", từ "upper bound" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The usual upper bound quoted is O(2ⁿ) time.", what does "upper bound" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: upper bound /ˈʌpər baʊnd/ (cụm từ): cận trên. "Upper bound" = cận trên, giới hạn không vượt quá; Big O thường mô tả cận trên.
items.explanationEn: upper bound /ˈʌpər baʊnd/ (phrase): a limit never exceeded. "Upper bound" is a limit that is never exceeded; Big O usually describes an upper bound.

items.question: Trong câu "The usual upper bound quoted is O(2ⁿ) time.", từ "quote" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The usual upper bound quoted is O(2ⁿ) time.", what does "quote" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: quote /kwəʊt/ (động từ): nêu ra, trích dẫn. "The bound quoted" = cận được nêu ra (thường thấy); nghĩa khác: "quote a price" = báo giá.
items.explanationEn: quote /kwəʊt/ (verb): to state, to cite. "The bound quoted" is the one commonly stated; another sense is "quote a price".

items.question: Trong câu "Space is only O(n), because at most n frames sit on the call stack at once.", từ "at most" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Space is only O(n), because at most n frames sit on the call stack at once.", what does "at most" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at most /æt məʊst/ (cụm từ): nhiều nhất là. "At most n frames" = tối đa n khung; trái nghĩa: "at least" (ít nhất).
items.explanationEn: at most /æt məʊst/ (phrase): no more than. "At most n frames" means n or fewer; the opposite is "at least".

items.question: Trong câu "Space is only O(n), because at most n frames sit on the call stack at once.", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Space is only O(n), because at most n frames sit on the call stack at once.", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /æt wʌns/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc. "Sit on the stack at once" = cùng nằm trên stack một lúc; nghĩa khác: "come at once" = đến ngay.
items.explanationEn: at once /æt wʌns/ (phrase): at the same time. "Sit on the stack at once" means simultaneously; another sense is "come at once" (immediately).

items.question: Trong câu "Memoization means storing the results of expensive function calls and returning the cached result when the same inputs occur again.", từ "expensive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Memoization means storing the results of expensive function calls and returning the cached result when the same inputs occur again.", what does "expensive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: expensive /ɪkˈspensɪv/ (tính từ): tốn tài nguyên. "Expensive function calls" = lời gọi hàm tốn thời gian/bộ nhớ, không phải tốn tiền.
items.explanationEn: expensive /ɪkˈspensɪv/ (adjective): costly in computing. "Expensive function calls" cost a lot of time or memory, not money.

items.question: Trong câu "Memoization means storing the results of expensive function calls and returning the cached result when the same inputs occur again.", từ "occur" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Memoization means storing the results of expensive function calls and returning the cached result when the same inputs occur again.", what does "occur" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: occur /əˈkɜːr/ (động từ): xảy ra. "When the same inputs occur again" = khi cùng đầu vào lại xuất hiện; danh từ: occurrence.
items.explanationEn: occur /əˈkɜːr/ (verb): to happen. "When the same inputs occur again" means when they happen again; noun: "occurrence".

items.question: Trong câu "Tracing fibMemo(6): the left spine computes each value once, and every right-hand call is a cache hit.", từ "trace" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tracing fibMemo(6): the left spine computes each value once, and every right-hand call is a cache hit.", what does "trace" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trace /treɪs/ (động từ): lần theo từng bước. "Trace a function call" = lần theo từng bước thực thi; "stack trace" = dấu vết ngăn xếp khi lỗi.
items.explanationEn: trace /treɪs/ (verb): to follow step by step. "Trace a function call" means following its execution step by step; compare "stack trace".

items.question: Trong câu "Space is O(n) for the memo plus O(n) recursion depth.", từ "depth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Space is O(n) for the memo plus O(n) recursion depth.", what does "depth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: depth /depθ/ (danh từ): độ sâu. "Recursion depth" = độ sâu đệ quy, số khung đang chồng trên stack; tính từ: deep.
items.explanationEn: depth /depθ/ (noun): how deep it goes. "Recursion depth" is how many frames are stacked; adjective: "deep".

items.question: Trong câu "fibMemo(n - 1) without the second argument creates a fresh empty cache on every call, silently bringing back O(2ⁿ).", từ "silently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "fibMemo(n - 1) without the second argument creates a fresh empty cache on every call, silently bringing back O(2ⁿ).", what does "silently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (trạng từ): âm thầm. "Silently bringing back O(2ⁿ)" = âm thầm làm chậm lại mà không báo lỗi; "fail silently" = lỗi mà không thông báo.
items.explanationEn: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (adverb): without warning. "Silently bringing back O(2ⁿ)" means it happens without any error; "fail silently" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "fibMemo(n - 1) without the second argument creates a fresh empty cache on every call, silently bringing back O(2ⁿ).", từ "bring back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "fibMemo(n - 1) without the second argument creates a fresh empty cache on every call, silently bringing back O(2ⁿ).", what does "bring back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: bring back /brɪŋ bæk/ (cụm từ): làm quay trở lại. "Bring back O(2ⁿ)" = làm độ phức tạp O(2ⁿ) quay trở lại; "bring back a book" = mang sách trả lại.
items.explanationEn: bring back /brɪŋ bæk/ (phrase): to cause to return. "Bring back O(2ⁿ)" means making that complexity return; "bring back a book" means returning it.

items.question: Trong câu "fibMemo(n - 1) without the second argument creates a fresh empty cache on every call, silently bringing back O(2ⁿ).", từ "fresh" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "fibMemo(n - 1) without the second argument creates a fresh empty cache on every call, silently bringing back O(2ⁿ).", what does "fresh" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fresh /freʃ/ (tính từ): mới tinh. "A fresh empty cache" = một bộ nhớ đệm mới tinh, rỗng; "fresh fruit" = trái cây tươi.
items.explanationEn: fresh /freʃ/ (adjective): brand new. "A fresh empty cache" is a brand-new one; "fresh fruit" uses the food sense.

items.explanationEn: denomination /dɪˌnɒmɪˈneɪʃən/ (noun): a coin's face value. "Coin denominations" are the face values of coins, e.g. 1, 2, 5.

items.question: Trong câu "Given denominations coins and an amount, return the number of combinations of coins that add up to the amount (unlimited supply of each coin).", từ "add up to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Given denominations coins and an amount, return the number of combinations of coins that add up to the amount (unlimited supply of each coin).", what does "add up to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: add up to /æd ʌp tə/ (cụm từ): cộng lại bằng. "Add up to the amount" = cộng lại bằng số tiền; "it doesn't add up" = nghe không hợp lý.
items.explanationEn: add up to /æd ʌp tə/ (phrase): to total. "Add up to the amount" means totalling it; "it doesn't add up" means it makes no sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Given denominations coins and an amount, return the number of combinations of coins that add up to the amount (unlimited supply of each coin).", từ "unlimited" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Given denominations coins and an amount, return the number of combinations of coins that add up to the amount (unlimited supply of each coin).", what does "unlimited" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unlimited /ʌnˈlɪmɪtɪd/ (tính từ): không giới hạn. "Unlimited supply" = số lượng không giới hạn; mỗi đồng xu dùng bao nhiêu lần cũng được.
items.explanationEn: unlimited /ʌnˈlɪmɪtɪd/ (adjective): without limit. "Unlimited supply" means each coin may be used any number of times.

items.question: Trong câu "Given denominations coins and an amount, return the number of combinations of coins that add up to the amount (unlimited supply of each coin).", từ "supply" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Given denominations coins and an amount, return the number of combinations of coins that add up to the amount (unlimited supply of each coin).", what does "supply" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (danh từ): lượng cung. "Supply of each coin" = lượng có sẵn của mỗi đồng xu; "supply and demand" = cung và cầu.
items.explanationEn: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (noun): available stock. "Supply of each coin" is how many are available; compare "supply and demand".

items.question: Trong câu "Process one coin at a time; for each amount a >= coin, add the ways to make a - coin.", từ "process" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Process one coin at a time; for each amount a >= coin, add the ways to make a - coin.", what does "process" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: process /ˈprəʊses/ (động từ): xử lý. "Process one coin at a time" = xử lý từng đồng xu một; danh từ "process" = tiến trình.
items.explanationEn: process /ˈprəʊses/ (verb): to handle. "Process one coin at a time" means handling them one by one; as a noun, a process is a running program.

items.question: Trong câu "The greedy idea — always take the largest coin that fits — works for real currencies like [1, 2, 5], but not in general.", từ "greedy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The greedy idea — always take the largest coin that fits — works for real currencies like [1, 2, 5], but not in general.", what does "greedy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: greedy /ˈɡriːdi/ (tính từ): tham lam. "Greedy algorithm" = thuật toán tham lam, luôn chọn lựa chọn tốt nhất trước mắt.
items.explanationEn: greedy /ˈɡriːdi/ (adjective): taking the best now. "Greedy algorithm" always takes the locally best choice at each step.

items.question: Trong câu "The greedy idea — always take the largest coin that fits — works for real currencies like [1, 2, 5], but not in general.", từ "currency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The greedy idea — always take the largest coin that fits — works for real currencies like [1, 2, 5], but not in general.", what does "currency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: currency /ˈkʌrənsi/ (danh từ): tiền tệ. "Real currencies" = các loại tiền tệ thật như VND, USD.
items.explanationEn: currency /ˈkʌrənsi/ (noun): a country's money. "Real currencies" are actual money systems such as USD or VND.

items.question: Trong câu "The greedy idea — always take the largest coin that fits — works for real currencies like [1, 2, 5], but not in general.", từ "in general" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The greedy idea — always take the largest coin that fits — works for real currencies like [1, 2, 5], but not in general.", what does "in general" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in general /ɪn ˈdʒenərəl/ (cụm từ): nói chung. "Not in general" = không đúng cho mọi trường hợp; "in general" = nói chung.
items.explanationEn: in general /ɪn ˈdʒenərəl/ (phrase): in all cases. "Not in general" means not true for every case; "in general" means overall.

items.question: Trong câu "With [3, 5] and amount 9, greedy takes 5 and gets stuck on 4, even though 3 + 3 + 3 works.", từ "get stuck" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With [3, 5] and amount 9, greedy takes 5 and gets stuck on 4, even though 3 + 3 + 3 works.", what does "get stuck" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to be unable to go on
items.explanation: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (cụm từ): bị mắc kẹt. "Get stuck on 4" = bị kẹt ở 4, không thể đi tiếp; "get stuck in traffic" = kẹt xe.
items.explanationEn: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (phrase): to be unable to go on. "Get stuck on 4" means being unable to continue; compare "get stuck in traffic".

items.question: Trong câu "With [3, 5] and amount 9, greedy takes 5 and gets stuck on 4, even though 3 + 3 + 3 works.", từ "even though" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With [3, 5] and amount 9, greedy takes 5 and gets stuck on 4, even though 3 + 3 + 3 works.", what does "even though" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: even though /ˈiːvən ðəʊ/ (liên từ): mặc dù. "Even though 3 + 3 + 3 works" = mặc dù 3 + 3 + 3 vẫn được; mạnh hơn "though".
items.explanationEn: even though /ˈiːvən ðəʊ/ (conjunction): although. "Even though 3 + 3 + 3 works" means despite that fact; it is stronger than "though".

items.question: Trong câu "Some states need two indices.", từ "index" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some states need two indices.", what does "index" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: index /ˈɪndeks/ (danh từ): chỉ số (vị trí). "Two indices" = hai chỉ số, ví dụ dp[r][c]; số nhiều: indices hoặc indexes.
items.explanationEn: index /ˈɪndeks/ (noun): a position number. "Two indices" are two position numbers, as in dp[r][c]; plural: "indices" or "indexes".

items.question: Trong câu "Unique grid paths: a robot starts top-left of a rows × cols grid and moves only right or down.", từ "grid" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unique grid paths: a robot starts top-left of a rows × cols grid and moves only right or down.", what does "grid" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: grid /ɡrɪd/ (danh từ): lưới ô vuông. "A rows × cols grid" = lưới gồm rows hàng và cols cột; "power grid" = lưới điện.
items.explanationEn: grid /ɡrɪd/ (noun): rows and columns of cells. "A rows × cols grid" is a pattern of rows and columns; compare "power grid".

items.question: Trong câu "Complexity: O(rows · cols) time and space; keeping only one row reduces space to O(cols).", từ "reduce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Complexity: O(rows · cols) time and space; keeping only one row reduces space to O(cols).", what does "reduce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reduce /rɪˈdjuːs/ (động từ): giảm. "Reduce space to O(cols)" = giảm bộ nhớ xuống O(cols); cấu trúc: reduce A to B.
items.explanationEn: reduce /rɪˈdjuːs/ (verb): to lower. "Reduce space to O(cols)" means lowering it to that level; pattern: reduce A to B.

items.question: Trong câu "Other classics follow the same recipe: 0/1 knapsack, longest common subsequence and edit distance (spell checkers, diff).", từ "recipe" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other classics follow the same recipe: 0/1 knapsack, longest common subsequence and edit distance (spell checkers, diff).", what does "recipe" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: recipe /ˈresəpi/ (danh từ): công thức giải. "Follow the same recipe" = làm theo cùng quy trình giải; nghĩa gốc là công thức nấu ăn.
items.explanationEn: recipe /ˈresəpi/ (noun): a solving method. "Follow the same recipe" means using the same step-by-step method; the basic sense is cooking.

items.question: Trong câu "Other classics follow the same recipe: 0/1 knapsack, longest common subsequence and edit distance (spell checkers, diff).", từ "common" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other classics follow the same recipe: 0/1 knapsack, longest common subsequence and edit distance (spell checkers, diff).", what does "common" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: common /ˈkɒmən/ (tính từ): chung (của cả hai). "Longest common subsequence" = dãy con chung dài nhất của hai chuỗi; nghĩa khác: "a common bug" = lỗi phổ biến.
items.explanationEn: common /ˈkɒmən/ (adjective): shared by both. "Longest common subsequence" is shared by both strings; another sense: "a common bug" (frequent).

items.question: Trong câu "DP also powers speech recognition, DNA sequence alignment, shortest-path algorithms like Bellman-Ford, and everyday caching.", từ "recognition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DP also powers speech recognition, DNA sequence alignment, shortest-path algorithms like Bellman-Ford, and everyday caching.", what does "recognition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: recognition /ˌrekəɡˈnɪʃən/ (danh từ): sự nhận dạng. "Speech recognition" = nhận dạng giọng nói; "gain recognition" = được công nhận.
items.explanationEn: recognition /ˌrekəɡˈnɪʃən/ (noun): identifying input. "Speech recognition" identifies spoken words; "gain recognition" means being praised.

items.question: Trong câu "DP also powers speech recognition, DNA sequence alignment, shortest-path algorithms like Bellman-Ford, and everyday caching.", từ "alignment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DP also powers speech recognition, DNA sequence alignment, shortest-path algorithms like Bellman-Ford, and everyday caching.", what does "alignment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alignment /əˈlaɪnmənt/ (danh từ): sự căn chỉnh. "DNA sequence alignment" = căn chỉnh chuỗi DNA để so sánh; "text alignment" = căn lề văn bản.
items.explanationEn: alignment /əˈlaɪnmənt/ (noun): lining things up. "DNA sequence alignment" lines sequences up to compare them; compare "text alignment".

items.question: Trong câu "Tabulation = bottom-up loop filling a table: O(n) time; with rolling variables O(1) space, and no stack overflow risk.", từ "overflow" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tabulation = bottom-up loop filling a table: O(n) time; with rolling variables O(1) space, and no stack overflow risk.", what does "overflow" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: overflow /ˈəʊvəfləʊ/ (danh từ): tràn (bộ nhớ). "Stack overflow" = tràn ngăn xếp khi đệ quy quá sâu.
items.explanationEn: overflow /ˈəʊvəfləʊ/ (noun): going past capacity. "Stack overflow" happens when recursion goes deeper than the stack allows.

items.question: Trong câu "Tabulation = bottom-up loop filling a table: O(n) time; with rolling variables O(1) space, and no stack overflow risk.", từ "risk" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tabulation = bottom-up loop filling a table: O(n) time; with rolling variables O(1) space, and no stack overflow risk.", what does "risk" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: risk /rɪsk/ (danh từ): nguy cơ. "No stack overflow risk" = không có nguy cơ tràn stack; "at risk" = gặp nguy.
items.explanationEn: risk /rɪsk/ (noun): a chance of harm. "No stack overflow risk" means no chance of that failure; "at risk" means in danger.

items.question: Trong câu "Say the recipe out loud: state → recurrence → base cases → order → answer; time = states × work per state.", từ "out loud" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Say the recipe out loud: state → recurrence → base cases → order → answer; time = states × work per state.", what does "out loud" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (cụm từ): thành tiếng. "Say it out loud" = nói thành tiếng; trong phỏng vấn nên nói to suy nghĩ của mình.
items.explanationEn: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (phrase): aloud. "Say it out loud" means speaking so others hear; interviewers want you to think out loud.

items.question: Trong câu "Coin change: loop order decides combinations vs permutations; greedy fails on coins like [1, 3, 4].", từ "permutation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Coin change: loop order decides combinations vs permutations; greedy fails on coins like [1, 3, 4].", what does "permutation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: permutation /ˌpɜːmjuˈteɪʃən/ (danh từ): hoán vị. "Combinations vs permutations" = tổ hợp (không tính thứ tự) và hoán vị (có tính thứ tự).
items.explanationEn: permutation /ˌpɜːmjuˈteɪʃən/ (noun): an ordered arrangement. "Combinations vs permutations": order does not matter in the first and does in the second.

items.question: Trong câu "It applies only when subproblems repeat and optimal answers compose.", từ "compose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It applies only when subproblems repeat and optimal answers compose.", what does "compose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compose /kəmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): ghép thành tổng thể. "Optimal answers compose" = các đáp án tối ưu ghép lại được thành đáp án tối ưu; danh từ: composition.
items.explanationEn: compose /kəmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to combine into a whole. "Optimal answers compose" means they combine into an optimal whole; noun: "composition".

items.question: Trong câu "Brute-force exponential solutions like Fibonacci, climbing stairs and coin change become linear or O(k · amount) with DP.", từ "exponential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Brute-force exponential solutions like Fibonacci, climbing stairs and coin change become linear or O(k · amount) with DP.", what does "exponential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: exponential /ˌekspəˈnenʃəl/ (tính từ): theo hàm mũ. "Exponential solutions" = lời giải có độ phức tạp hàm mũ như O(2ⁿ); đối lập: linear (tuyến tính).
items.explanationEn: exponential /ˌekspəˈnenʃəl/ (adjective): growing like 2ⁿ. "Exponential solutions" grow like O(2ⁿ); the contrast here is "linear".
